ruleDefinitions.name: Esentutl Steals Browser Information
ruleDefinitions.description: One way Qbot steals sensitive information is by extracting browser data from Internet Explorer and Microsoft Edge by using the built-in utility esentutl.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\esentutl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "esentutl\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/r.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\WebCache.*"))
